pages.title: Changes
pages.text: This port follows Mariculture 1.3.0 for 1.7.10, the last beta, and keeps the fixes from the 1.2.4 stable release. Most things work as they did. This entry lists the differences a returning player will notice.$(br2)Worlds from 1.7.10 do not convert.

pages.title: Power and Guides
pages.text: Machines run on Forge Energy (FE), so any FE generator or cable powers them. MariTech and the Factory are part of the main mod, so every machine is always there.$(br2)The separate guide books are now this one Compendium. It is given once on first join and can be crafted from a book and any fish.

pages.title: Tanks and Hatcheries
pages.text: Fish tanks hold one normal stack per slot and drop their contents when broken. All 54 slots are open to hoppers and pipes.$(br2)Hatcheries placed next to each other now hatch faster, as the original meant them to.

pages.title: Genetics
pages.text: The DNA Injector writes every DNA it holds into the fish, not one picked at random. The DNA Extractor keeps its progress when its battery runs dry.$(br2)Metal fish come from eggs laid with metal storage blocks touching the breeding water. Each metal fish needs its metal in the game, from vanilla or another mod.

pages.title: Rods and Zombies
pages.text: The Livingwood rod needs Botania and the Bound rod needs Blood Magic or Neo Vitae. Without those mods neither rod shows up.$(br2)Zombies spawn with a fishing hat or rod about 1 time in 80. A bug in the original made it about 1 in 9.

pages.title: Machine Menus
pages.text: Machine slots have coloured borders: blue for inputs, orange for outputs and yellow for fuel, batteries and rods. An empty slot shows a faint picture of what goes there and names it on hover.$(br2)Shift-clicking an item puts it in the slot made for it. Fuel, battery, rod and upgrade slots take nothing else.

pages.title: Data Packs
pages.text: Vat, crucible, anvil and casting recipes, crucible fuels and fishing loot are data. Data packs, KubeJS and CraftTweaker can add or remove them, and /reload applies the change.$(br2)The handcrank named in the 1.3.0 changelog never existed in its code and is not in this port.
